mapping_contract.existing_formula_source: Scripts/Animation/prepare_das_animation_timing.py:mapped_events lines290-334 and bake lines1010-1032; exact60 V5 migration preserves normalized endpoints.
mapping_contract.formula: t_baked = piecewise_linear_interp(t_source + trigger_offset, DilationAnimPositions.T_Original, DilationAnimPositions.T_Dilation) * (stored_frames / 60) / DilationSequenceLength. Without active dilation use t_source * (stored_frames / 60) / source SequenceLength. End uses EndLink.LinkValue + EndTriggerTimeOffset.
mapping_contract.time_units: seconds; montage offsets assume continuous sequential sections at playrate1 and no skipped Start.
mapping_contract.calculation_status: Recalculated solely into this plan from current cached originals plus saved exact60 audits; no asset timeline changed.
mapping_contract.clip_policy: Full baked source clips are proposed for duplication; their baked dilation is retained. Arbitrary crop/re-time is not planned. Segment trim/rate/loop source fields remain preserved in source_animation_track. No exact player-to-victim pose sync/native hold reconstruction is claimed.

death_recovery_policy.alive: Requested max-stamina restoration and departure from exhaustion are gameplay consequences. Exhaustion End and victim completion are available presentation boundaries; source metadata does not prove a mandatory independent Recovery_StaminaRecover clip.
death_recovery_policy.dead: Do not restore stamina on death. Explicit Swordsman Brutal death references are selected. Five other families have GroundDie fallback candidates, with native Brutal death selection still unconfirmed. Down/BackDown loops and Wraith variants excluded.
